name: skills
description: The open agent skills tool - npx skills
one_liner: A command-line tool that installs ready-made 'skills' into whichever AI coding assistant you use, so it instantly knows how to do a specific job well.
buyer: A developer-tools team that wants to distribute a packaged workflow (e.g. 'how to deploy to our platform') to every developer's AI assistant in one command.
business_use_cases: A platform company (hosting, database, API) publishes an official skill so any developer's AI coding agent instantly knows how to integrate with their product correctly.
An internal platform team at a mid-size company packages their deployment/security conventions as a skill so every engineer's AI assistant follows the same rules automatically.
A dev-tools consultancy builds and sells custom skill packs for clients standardizing how their teams use AI coding agents.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a marketplace/registry for paid, vetted skill packs built on top of the free open CLI.
Sell custom skill-authoring services to companies wanting their product baked into every developer's AI agent.

steal_this: This is mostly open developer infrastructure from Vercel itself; the realistic weekend project is writing and publishing one well-made niche skill to build an audience, not building a competing business around the tool.
